plan.scoreSub: {{red}} answers need a little attention — here's your coaching plan.
plan.allGreen: Everything is as per LAP. Wonderful work!
plan.needsAttentionSub: A gentle coaching to-do list based on this assessment.

plan.proteinSub: Computed from the food and supplement grids of this visit.

checks.impossible_wfa: This weight is not possible for the baby's age. Check the scale and weigh the baby again.
checks.impossible_lfa: This length is not possible for the baby's age. Measure the length again.
checks.impossible_wfl: This weight and length do not fit together. Measure both again.
checks.typing_error: This weight is very different from the last one ({{previous}} kg on {{date}}). It may be a typing mistake: check the number, or weigh the baby again.
checks.weight_loss_refer: The baby has lost {{pct}}% of the weight since the last check ({{previous}} kg). Weigh again. If the weight is right, look for danger signs and refer the baby today.
checks.weight_loss_revisit: The baby has lost {{pct}}% of the weight since the last check ({{previous}} kg). Ask about diarrhoea, fever and feeding, and visit again within {{days}} days.
checks.newborn_loss: The baby is {{pct}}% below the birth weight ({{birth}} kg). Weigh again. If the weight is right, look for danger signs and refer the baby today.
checks.length_shorter: This length is {{cm}} cm shorter than last time ({{previous}} cm). Measure again, with two people holding the baby.
checks.mustConfirm: Check the flagged measurement: measure again, or confirm that it is right.
